import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long addMod(long x, long y) {
        return (x + y) % MOD;
    }

    static long subMod(long x, long y) {
        x -= y;
        return (x < 0) ? x + MOD : x;
    }

    static long multiplyMod(long x, long y) {
        return (x * y) % MOD;
    }

    static long powerMod(long base, long exp) {
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) return multiplyMod(base, powerMod(base, exp - 1));
        long half = powerMod(base, exp >> 1);
        return multiplyMod(half, half);
    }

    static long inverseMod(long x) {
        return powerMod(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static int size_n;
    static List<long[]> matrixA;
    static long[][][] T_table;
    static List<Map<Long, Long>> DP_states;
    static int[] family_count;
    static int[] family_index;
    static List<List<Integer>> family_masks;

    static void precompute() {
        family_masks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= size_n; i++) {
            family_masks.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << size_n); ++mask) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            if (family_count == null || family_count.length <= mask) {
                // initialize if needed
            }
            if (family_count != null) {
                family_count[mask] = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            }
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << size_n); ++mask) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            family_index[mask] = family_masks.get(count).size();
            family_masks.get(count).add(mask);
        }
        T_table = new long[size_n + 1][];
        for (int k = 0; k <= size_n; ++k) {
            T_table[k] = new long[family_masks.get(k).size() * (1 << size_n)];
            for (int i = 0; i < family_masks.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                int current_mask = family_masks.get(k).get(i);
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << size_n); ++mask) {
                    long answer = 0;
                    if ((mask & current_mask) == mask) continue;
                    for (int x = 0; x < size_n; ++x) {
                        if ((current_mask & (1 << x)) != 0) continue;
                        if ((mask & (1 << x)) == 0) continue;
                        int new_mask = current_mask | (1 << x);
                        answer |= (1L << family_index[new_mask]);
                    }
                    T_table[k][i * (1 << size_n) + mask] = answer;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        size_n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        matrixA = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            long[] row = new long[size_n];
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; j++) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(parts[j]);
                row[j] = multiplyMod(val, inverseMod(100));
            }
            matrixA.add(row);
        }
        family_count = new int[1 << size_n];
        family_index = new int[1 << size_n];
        precompute();

        DP_states = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= size_n; i++) {
            DP_states.add(new HashMap<>());
        }
        DP_states.get(0).put(1L, 1L);

        for (int k = 0; k < size_n; ++k) {
            Map<Long, Long> currentDP = DP_states.get(k);
            Map<Long, Long> nextDP = DP_states.get(k + 1);
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentDP.entrySet()) {
                long mask = entry.getKey();
                long val = entry.getValue();

                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < size_n; ++i) {
                    long p;
                    if (((mask & (1L << i)) != 0))
                        p = matrixA.get(k)[i];
                    else
                        p = subMod(1, matrixA.get(k)[i]);
                    prob = multiplyMod(prob, p);
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < family_masks.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                    int family_mask = family_masks.get(k).get(i);
                    long new_mask = 0;
                    long p = multiplyMod(prob, val);
                    for (int j = 0; j < family_masks.get(k).size(); ++j) {
                        if (((mask & (1L << j)) != 0))
                            new_mask |= T_table[k][i * (1 << size_n) + j];
                    }
                    if (new_mask != 0) {
                        nextDP.put(new_mask, addMod(nextDP.getOrDefault(new_mask, 0L), p));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(DP_states.get(size_n).getOrDefault(1L, 0L));
    }
}
